title: A supervisor that routes, follows hand-offs and knows when to stop
checks: [route(t) for t in ('refund please', 'login error', 'where is my parcel', 'hello')] == ['billing', 'technical', 'delivery', 'human']
A simple ticket is handled by one agent
supervise('I want a refund', AGENTS) == {'handled_by': 'billing', 'transcript': [('billing', 'Refund approved.')], 'escalated': False}
supervise('login error then parcel missing', AGENTS)['handled_by'] == 'delivery' and len(supervise('login error then parcel missing', AGENTS)['transcript']) == 2
Ping-pong is escalated before it starts

supervise('the app shows a charge twice', AGENTS) == {'handled_by': 'human', 'transcript': [('billing', 'The charge looks right; the app problem is for technical.'), ('technical', 'The app is fine; the charge is a billing question.')], 'escalated': True}
supervise('parcel refund and app login', AGENTS, max_handoffs=1)['escalated'] is True
Unmatched tickets go to a human
